official_definition: (Once per Turn: Same Name) By sending your 20px or the opposing 20px to the Trash, or by -1 opposing counter, stacking this card from your Hand onto its target, including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Reverse Contract Advent] or [Reverse Contract Advent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Reverse Contract Advent]", "give [Reverse Contract Advent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
